title: Quality Studio Review Flow
summary: Decision-ready operator dossier for the complete Quality Studio review journey: one scope-owned launch surface, backend-owned model recommendation on top of the QS-56 catalog, inline preflight, active run visibility, a QS-55-readable findings queue, bidirectional finding-to-code navigation, explicit Accept/Dismiss/Ignore semantics, API-owned management for the existing .quality/scope.json list, and immutable per-run outcomes for fingerprint-aligned comparison. Recommends the session-centered three-pane workspace (Option B) and provides approval-ready Slices S0-S6 with acceptance contracts.
